summary: Iteration 2 verified all requested changes. Backend: existing contact API tests (11/11) still pass; new rate-limit test confirms 429 on 6th POST per IP within 10 min using isolated X-Forwarded-For. Email background notify_owner runs without 'Owner notification failed' entries in backend logs. Frontend: hero-tilt-stack big card and project-card-zerohour both load /assets/zerohour.webp (soldier by brick wall); hero small icon and project-card-recoilbot both load /assets/recoil.webp (yellow helmet smiley); project-card-typingsurvival renders with typingsurvival-play-link -> https://www.roblox.com/games/93071775781153/Typing-Survival; nav-link-now scrolls to #now (current-project-section) with 'Color the World.' heading; hovering flag-france/germany/japan increments flag-count from 0/24 -> 3/24, flag-reset-btn restores 0/24. Mobile 390px shows no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to lifespan context manager.
In-memory _RATE dict in server.py grows unbounded (keyed by IP); add periodic pruning or use TTL cache to prevent slow memory growth.
rate_limited() takes the first value of X-Forwarded-For without validating trust — behind the Emergent ingress this is OK but worth noting for future deployments behind different proxies.
notify_owner swallows exceptions silently (only logs); consider adding retry/backoff or a lightweight dead-letter log collection so missed owner emails are recoverable.
seed_data_creation: Rate-limit test created 5 TEST_RL_* contact messages under a synthetic X-Forwarded-For and deleted all via DELETE /api/contact/{id} in a finally block. 1 additional TEST_User1 message created+deleted by test_contact_api.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/{test_contact_api.py,test_rate_limit.py}. Rate limit = 5/IP/10min; use a unique X-Forwarded-For header per test run to avoid colliding with other callers. notify_owner sends real email to alieu.bojang@icloud.com for every valid POST — keep contact POSTs minimal and TEST_-prefixed with cleanup.
